text: Yes, the 2023 tree-cover loss on this property is confirmed. The Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (both 2023 and 2025 versions) consistently detected a 4.5-hectare loss event in 2023, meeting the minimum event size threshold of 0.5 hectares. The JRC 2020 reference data corroborates this, showing the area was fully forested in 2020. The Uruguayan MGAP forest map further identifies the area as planted forest (Pinus spp.), not native forest. While 1.3 hectares of smaller patches were excluded from the event count, the core loss area is validated across multiple independent datasets and meets all corroboration rules.
